inputs.text: [curious] AR… keh… lon. [pauses] Two pieces, both Greek. "Arche" means chief, first — [serious] like in "archaeology."

[warmly] The whole name, yes — the biggest turtle of all time. She lived in a sea that cut North America in half, [amazed] seventy-five million years ago, [pauses] with Tylosaurus and old sharks for dangerous neighbors.
